title: Cornerstone Cove | KEY.co
description_expanded: Cornerstone Cove is a coastal sanctuary where modern elegance meets relaxed beachside living. Nestled at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac, this stunning four-bedroom retreat, including a private mother-in-law suite, offers an idyllic escape for multi-family vacations. Expansive balconies provide sweeping views of the heated, screened pool and glimpses of the ocean beyond, while the home’s airy, open-concept design invites seamless indoor-outdoor living. Just a short four-minute stroll from private beach access, this serene getaway blends the best of resort-style luxury with the comforts of home. Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, the thoughtfully curated spaces encourage connection and ease. A gourmet kitchen sets the stage for memorable meals, best enjoyed al fresco in the lush outdoor dining area. The dedicated game room promises endless fun, while ample lounge seating around the pool offers the perfect spot to unwind beneath swaying palm trees.

Features: With parking available for up to six vehicles.
